answer: Reaching eligibility takes 66 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. The opal register is checked at draw time, zephyr lists the eligible set, and zenith seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 66 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Bonded capital sits idle for 8 days. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
